entities.summary: Darren Charles Waller is an American professional football tight end for the Miami Dolphins of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets and was selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the sixth round of the 2015 NFL draft.
